plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-16 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). The map is headed 'Fire Technology map for 2026-2027' and the pathway is for catalog year 2026-2027. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. Card View and Table View agreed exactly on every row. The inventoried program 'Fire Technology' is listed in the mapper under the name 'Fire Technology'; the program details state the student will be awarded an Associate of Arts degree. This plan transcribes the program's 'to Degree' pathway, 'Fire Technology / Associate of Arts / 60-61.5 units / 4 terms / to Degree', in full. The program's second 2026-2027 pathway ('to CSU', 65-66.5 units, 4 terms) is a different, CalGETC-based map and is not collected as a separate plan. In 2025-2026 the same 'to Degree' pathway was listed at 60-61.5 units in 6 terms (a leading milestone-only term and a trailing milestone-only term around the same four content terms) with the same course content, except that FIRE B3's title is printed there as 'Fire Command, Strategy, & Tactics'; in 2026-2027 it is printed, in both views, as 'Fire Command, Strategy, and Tactics' and is transcribed here exactly as printed for 2026-2027. The mapper also lists a separate Fire Technology Certificate of Achievement program, a different credential, which was not transcribed. The transcribed map prints the degree total as a range, 60-61.5 units, and term totals as 15-16.5 / 16 / 13 / 16. The only ranged row is Term 1 '1.A. English Communication (BC)' (3-4.5). Per the standing minimum-credit convention it is recorded at its printed minimum, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum and the plan total is the printed minimum of 60 units. No row on the map shows a 'Prerequisites', 'Corequisites' or 'Dual Enrollment' flag in Card View, so no prereqs are recorded. General-education, major-list and elective slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated. Milestone rows printed on the map carry no course content and are not encoded; unlike the other maps collected this wave, this map prints no 'After Completion Milestones' row in its final term. The map page states verbatim: 'This program map represents one possible pathway through the program and may not reflect the most current catalog requirements. Make an appointment to create a customized education plan that fits your needs.'
